data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Norse word halðr, meaning 'ruler' or 'leader'. In Norse mythology, Haldan was the name of several legendary kings. The name Haldan carries the meaning “Ruler, Leader” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Haldan usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haldan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: In Norse mythology, "Haldan" was the name of several legendary kings. This name carries a great cultural impact that signifies leadership and power. It symbolizes the importance of having a strong and wise ruler in a community, guiding its people through both good and challenging times.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, "Haldan" represents strength, courage, and wisdom. In Christian context, it can be seen as a reminder of God's leadership and authority in our lives. The name inspires us to be strong in faith and to trust in God as our ultimate leader, guide, and protector. Just as a Haldan, a great king in Norse mythology, provides for and protects his people, so does God in our spiritual journey. Additionally, this name can embody the qualities of Christ, who is referred to as the King of Kings and Lord of Lords in the Bible.
